summary: Backend testing of POST /api/admin/products/normalize-order (bug fix commit 1423a38). All 10 tests passed covering auth gating, sequential per-category ordering, placeLast pinning, error paths, idempotency, sorting, and move-endpoint regression.
critical_code_review_comments: products.py line 443-444: When placeLast product is not in the target category, endpoint returns 400 ('Product is not in the specified category'). The test spec requested 404 for that case but the current 400 is arguably more semantically correct (product exists, just not a category member). Not a bug; noted for E1's awareness.
products.py is ~490 lines — within acceptable limits.
_normalize_order helper correctly matches on {'categoryIds': category_id} which requires the multi-category schema to be backfilled — main agent noted this was done in preview.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing preview products in Self-Care Tools category (11 products including Bio Blade).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_normalize_order.py covers full endpoint contract. Idempotency verified from run 2->3 identical. placeLast pins Bio Blade last with order=highest+10. Move endpoint regression verified (top-up=noop, bottom-down=noop, mid-down swaps). Self-Care Tools has 11 products in preview.
